ADHD-pakkeforløb is the structured treatment framework and standardized care process for ADHD patients within the psychiatric healthcare system [^src1]. It serves as the foundational model for delivering treatment, but its structural design has become a focal point of debate regarding the integration of psychotherapy into adult ADHD care [^src1]. 

Within the context of the annual quality report evaluating the newly introduced Indicator 9—which measures the provision of psychotherapy to adults with ADHD—the limitations of the ADHD-pakkeforløb have been heavily scrutinized [^src1]. The framework is fundamentally constrained by its limited scope, specifically its duration as a [[9-timers-pakke]] (9-hour package) [^src1]. This restricted timeframe is identified as a central structural barrier, as it is not inherently designed to accommodate the extensive hours typically required to incorporate meaningful psychotherapeutic interventions [^src1]. 

The broader narrative surrounding this entity emerges from the first-year results of Indicator 9, which were based on a shortened reporting period from April 1 to July 31, 2025 [^src1]. During this period, national fulfillment of the psychotherapy indicator was extremely low at just 1%, with data being limited both quantitatively and geographically [^src1]. This widespread non-fulfillment prompted strategic discussions within the steering group regarding the structural capacity of the ADHD-pakkeforløb, the prioritization of quality indicators, and the redefinition of the target population—such as whether to exclude data reported from child and adolescent psychiatric outpatient clinics from the adult population metrics [^src1]. Ultimately, the limited capacity of the 9-hour package sets the boundaries for future political and clinical development of ADHD treatment standards [^src1].

## Mentions
- Page 46: "Det ses at et ikke ubetydeligt antal forløb indrapporteres fra børne- og ungdomspsykiatriske ambulatorier, og det drøftes i styregruppen om ikke disse skal udgå fra voksenpopulationen. Dertil bemærkes det, at den aktuelle ADHD-behandlingspakke på 9 timer ikke i udgangspunktet er af et omfang, der kan inkorporere psykoterapi." [^src1]
